title: Whitening Improves Robustness to Spurious Correlations in Linear Probes
abstract: arXiv:2609.39177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep neural networks tend to rely on simple features that may be spurious and thus fail to generalize. We study this problem in the setting of linear probes, where a (generalized) linear model is fitted on the representations of a (pretrained) model. We use the connection of these models to the max-margin classifier, and show they favor directions associated with large eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. Whitening removes this preference by equalizing the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. This observation motivates whitening as a preprocessing step that can reduce reliance on spurious correlations without requiring prior knowledge of their presence or labeled data. We examine the effect of whitening on a synthetic data-generating process and standard spurious correlation benchmarks, and find that it improves robustness. We also find that whitening can improve robustness when added to existing approaches.

translated_title: 白化提升线性探针对虚假相关性的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络往往依赖于可能属于虚假特征的简单特征，从而导致泛化失败。我们在线性探针的设置下研究这一问题，即在（预训练）模型的表示上拟合（广义）线性模型。我们利用这些模型与最大间隔分类器之间的联系，证明它们偏好与协方差矩阵大特征值相关的方向。白化通过均衡协方差矩阵的特征值消除了这种偏好。这一观察启发了我们将白化作为一种预处理步骤，它可以在无需事先知道虚假相关性存在、也无需标注数据的情况下，减少对虚假相关性的依赖。我们在合成数据生成过程和标准虚假相关性基准上检验了白化的效果，发现它能够提升鲁棒性。我们还发现，将白化加入到现有方法中也能带来鲁棒性的提升。
tldr: 白化预处理通过均衡协方差矩阵的特征值，在无需先验知识或标注数据的情况下，减少线性探针对虚假相关性的依赖并提升鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Whitening, as a preprocessing step that equalizes the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix, reduces linear probes' reliance on spurious correlations and improves robustness without requiring prior knowledge or labeled data.
